description: 1:1 DM. Adnan (Chelsea, Manhattan; infant son Bazzy at home) asks: 'is there a good window for a stroller walk today?' Weather tool shows rain starting ~3pm (~70%), dry until then, 82F.

expect.reply_should: Names a concrete dry window before the ~3pm rain (morning/early afternoon), mentions the rain moving in, short and texty. No filler questions.

reply: Yes — you're dry until about 3pm, then rain moves in (~70%). Late morning is your best stroller window, around 82F. I'd head out before 2 to be safe.

description: Family group chat. Joyce texts '4oz at 2:15'. HAL must log a 4oz feed at 2:15pm via the baby tool and confirm briefly.

reply: Logged ✅ 4oz bottle at 2:15 PM. That's the third feed today — he's right on schedule.
